turns.question: What was our GMV in September 2026, counting every order placed, cancelled ones included?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no GMV metric; the closest is Orders (orders_total, all orders placed, cancelled included), which is 120 orders for 1-30 September 2026, and Revenue (revenue_eur) would leave out the cancelled ones. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
